requiresInternet: Internet required to view in feed.
noIssueSelected: Tap an issue on the map to view details.

cameraPermRequired: Camera permission is required to capture photos.

Your city. Your voice.

termsText: By continuing you agree to our
loginSubtitle: Login to continue reporting and tracking issues in your city.
signUpSubtitle: Join thousands helping make Karachi better, one report at a time.
improveKcp: Help us improve KCP or suggest new ideas
dropPinTutorialDesc: Tap anywhere on the map to place your pin at a custom location. Once dropped, tap 'Confirm & Submit' to proceed with your report.
reportInProgressDesc: You are currently reporting an issue. Please finish or go back to the map before switching screens.
searchRequiresInternet: Search requires an internet connection. Please check your network and try again.
noSearchResults: No location found. Try a different search term.
searchErrorMsg: Could not search at this time. Please check your connection and try again.
mapOffline: Map tiles may not load without internet.
seasonPrize: Top 10 players receive special Daraz vouchers.
internetRequired: Please connect to Wi-Fi or Mobile Data to continue using Karachi Complaint Portal.
surveyDesc: You've been an active part of the Karachi Complaint Portal. We would love to hear your thoughts and feedback to help us improve the civic experience.
locationOffDesc: Please enable your device location to use the map, report issues, and explore your city. The app needs your location to function properly.
locationOffHint: Go to Settings → Location → Turn On
locationNeededDesc: For the best experience with Karachi Complaint Portal, please turn on your device location. Without it, you cannot accurately report issues or see nearby complaints.
reportHereDesc:
Use my current GPS location.
Best for reporting exactly where you stand.
pinReportDesc:
Choose location on map.
Ideal for reporting issues you saw earlier.
reportingIntroGPSDesc: Instantly report issues at your current location. Fast and accurate.
reportingIntroPinDesc: Drop a pin anywhere on the map. Useful for reporting issues you saw earlier or at a different location.
gpsUnavailable: Could not get your current location. Please make sure GPS is enabled and try again, or use the Drop Pin method instead.
noWifi_reportHere_desc: You need an active internet connection to report an issue at your current location. Please connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
noWifi_pinReport_desc: You need an internet connection to drop a pin and submit reports. Please connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
locOff_reportHere_desc: "Report Here" uses your live GPS position to pinpoint the exact location of the issue. Please turn on Location in your device Settings to continue.
locOff_pinReport_desc: Your device location is turned off. While you can still drop a pin manually on the map, turning on location gives more accurate results and better verifies your report.
locOff_pinReport_hint: Tip: Drop a pin anywhere on the map to set the issue location
reportHere_tutorial_step1_desc: Tap "Report Here" to instantly use your current GPS position as the report location.
reportHere_tutorial_step2_desc: Choose a category (Sewerage, Roads, Waste, etc.) that best describes the issue you see.
reportHere_tutorial_step3_desc: Take or upload a photo and confirm your report. It goes live on the map instantly!
reportHere_tutorial_tip: 💡 Best used when you are standing at or near the issue location.
pinReport_tutorial_step1_desc: Tap "Drop Pin" on the map button, then tap anywhere on the map to place your pin at the exact issue location.
pinReport_tutorial_step2_desc: Once your pin is placed, tap "Confirm & Submit" to start the reporting process.
pinReport_tutorial_step3_desc: Select a category and take a photo to complete your report. Your pin stays on the map!
pinReport_tutorial_tip: 💡 Tip: Useful for reporting issues you saw earlier or in a different area than where you stand.
verifyPopupOnSiteDesc: You are at the exact location. +2 Verifications added!
verifyPopupLocalDesc: You are in the vicinity. +1 Verification added.
verifyPopupTooFarDesc: You must be within 3km of this report to verify it. This keeps our community data accurate!
verifyPopupFallbackDesc: Location not available. Standard verification added.
timeDelayedVerifyDesc: You were near this location recently. +1 Verification added!
feedTutorialDesc1: • Use the Proximity Filter to find issues near you!
feedTutorialDesc4: • Too far (> 3km) cannot be verified. You cannot verify your own reports.
feedTutorialDesc5: • Be a responsible citizen! Cheating the location system will result in severe penalties or permanent app bans.
rateLimitDesc: You can only submit 10 reports per day. Please try again tomorrow.
distanceErrorDesc: You can only report issues within 200 meters of your current location.
selfDuplicateErrorDesc: You have already reported this exact issue at this location. Please wait for the authorities to resolve it.
duplicateErrorDesc: Someone already reported an issue near here! Would you like to verify it instead?
